selection: Top 1024 central-brain bridges by visual-incoming x descending-outgoing synapse counts; top 2048 visual projection neurons by input to bridge/DN set; all annotated descending neurons. Induced subgraph, no invented biological edges.
dynamics: Six tanh rate-propagation steps per observation, zero initial activity; W[post,pre]=NT-sign(pre)*count/sum_incoming(post); uniform gain 1.6. No biophysical time calibration.
